stem: Which nuclear medicine scan provides differential function information for each kidney in a child with renal tract concerns?
explanation: DMSA scan provides differential renal function information for each kidney and is a static nuclear medicine study.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Correct because DMSA scan is a static nuclear medicine study that provides differential function information for each kidney.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because abdominal ultrasound does not provide differential renal function information in the same way as a DMSA scan.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because abdominal X-ray does not measure differential renal function.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because renal Doppler ultrasound assesses renal blood flow rather than differential renal function of each kidney.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because ophthalmology review is not a renal nuclear medicine study.
